description: Loads read-only GitHub Issue task context at prompt submission and guards HANDOFF updates at stop.

hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$current = (Get-Location).Path; $script = $null; while ($current) { $candidate = Join-Path $current '.codex\hooks\handoff_guard.py'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $candidate) { $script = $candidate; break }; $parent = Split-Path -Parent $current; if ($parent -eq $current) { break }; $current = $parent }; if ($script) { & py -3 $script --event prompt } else { '{}' }"

powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$current = (Get-Location).Path; $script = $null; while ($current) { $candidate = Join-Path $current '.codex\hooks\handoff_guard.py'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $candidate) { $script = $candidate; break }; $parent = Split-Path -Parent $current; if ($parent -eq $current) { break }; $current = $parent }; if ($script) { & py -3 $script --event stop } else { '{}' }"
